# Telex Business Support Services Inc. (TelexPH)
> Philippine-based BPO specializing in AI-integrated business support and GHL-certified administration.

## Summary
TelexPH provides offshore staffing and automation workflows for global businesses. We integrate certified GoHighLevel (GHL) admins with AI systems to optimize CRMs, funnels, and operations.

## Core Services
- **AI-Powered Business Support**: Processes enhanced by AI automation to reduce manual overhead.
- **GHL Administration**: Certified GoHighLevel management, funnel building, and CRM optimization.
- **Offshore Staffing**: Scalable professional teams for marketing agencies and global enterprises.
- **Customer Experience (CX)**: 24/7 customer support outsourcing for US/UK/AU/CA businesses.
- **Back Office Solutions**: Data entry, admin support, and business process management.
- **Virtual Assistance**: Dedicated virtual assistants trained in tools like GHL, Slack, and Notion.
- **Sales & Lead Generation**: Outbound campaigns, CRM management, and pipeline automation.
